SELECT caller_symbol_id, usage FROM (
  SELECT caller_symbol_id, 'direct' AS usage
  FROM code.calls
  WHERE callee_symbol_id = 'rich.progress.Progress.get_renderable'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT caller_symbol_id, 'callback' AS usage
  FROM code.calls c1
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.calls c2
    WHERE c2.caller_symbol_id = c1.caller_symbol_id
      AND c2.callee_symbol_id = 'rich.progress.Progress.get_renderable'
  )
  AND c1.call_kind = 'callback'
)
ORDER BY caller_symbol_id
